steps.what: Determine counselling priorities, required skills and patient access needs
Coordinate appointments and resolve service scheduling conflicts

tasks.design: Configure {CALENDAR} appointment rules from the dietitian's allocation brief. The dietitian reviews suggested slots, resolves access conflicts and confirms the schedule; clinical priority is never inferred from calendar availability.
tasks.previous_blocker: Availability checks and manual coordination recur around clinical allocation decisions.
tasks.enabler_now: Native calendar constraints and reusable appointment types may reduce repeated slot searches.
tasks.still_hard: Capacity shortages and individual access requirements.
tasks.human_edge: Make fair clinical allocations and negotiate exceptions.
tasks.altitude: Less slot searching, with unchanged clinical service responsibility.

reach.learn: Agree escalation routes without disclosing unnecessary clinical information

evidence.claim: Calendar constraint configuration is a plausible scheduling aid; no local service coordination saving is documented in this digest.

assumptions: Boundary is dietitian coordination, excluding clinical counselling and patient attendance.

Dietitian produces patient reference, priority, skill need, duration and access constraints in s1, with capture time retained in its 40 hours. Staff maintain availability through existing calendar processes; additional correction work is counted below.
Check native calendar booking rules first. Missing allocation fields require manual scheduling in s2 rather than guessed clinical routing.
Patient confirmation and difficult conflicts remain within s2's retained effort; no saving is transferred to patients.
unknowns: Ownership and quality of availability data
research_questions: Do rule-based slot suggestions save time after access exceptions and calendar corrections?

already_counted.description: Slot review, access exceptions and schedule confirmation

incremental.description: Allocation rule upkeep and failed booking reconciliation

approvals.approved_version: Exact appointment allocation, patient references, staff, access arrangements and slots; changes require reconfirmation

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=40+42=82, gross=18, focal upkeep=4, net=14. High requires reusable slot rules reducing scheduling effort by 30%; low retains all coordination effort when access conflicts dominate and still incurs upkeep.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Define curriculum objectives and select authoritative teaching sources
Prepare manuals, visual aids and course outlines from selected sources

loop.input: Teaching brief and selected source pack
loop.output: Draft outline, manual sections and visual descriptions with source references
loop.check: Dietitian checks nutritional meaning, source support, audience comprehension and consistency across visuals and text
loop.stop: One draft per section; unsupported content returns to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Audience-appropriate explanation and synthesis require contextual wording

steps.what: Check curriculum coherence and approve final teaching materials

tasks.design: Use {DOCS} templates and a bounded draft from selected sources. The dietitian sets learning objectives, checks every clinical explanation and visual, and approves the exact teaching pack before distribution.
tasks.previous_blocker: Turning source guidance into consistent teaching artefacts takes repeated composition.
tasks.enabler_now: Source-constrained drafting can propose wording and outlines; nutritional and pedagogical validation remain necessary.
tasks.still_hard: Preventing misleading simplification and unsupported visual claims.
tasks.human_edge: Judge what learners need and which misunderstandings matter.
tasks.altitude: Less initial composition; curriculum ownership stays with the dietitian.

reach.learn: Test explanations with the intended audience

evidence.claim: Thuisarts provides guideline-based patient information; it can support selected patient-facing explanations, not an entire professional curriculum.
The constrained teaching-material draft and its time estimate are unmeasured design assumptions.

assumptions: Boundary is material preparation, separate from delivering training; roll-ups allocate each teaching pack once.
Dietitian produces objectives, learner level, source versions and allowed topics in s1, retaining its full 25 hours for selection and capture. No external source extraction is treated as free.
Try native document templates first. Drafts with missing or conflicting source support return to manual composition.
Four additional focal hours cover source updates, template maintenance and sample audits.
research_questions: Can source-linked drafting shorten composition while preserving comprehension and nutritional accuracy?

incremental.description: Source updates, templates and sample audits

approvals.approved_version: Exact outline, manual text, visuals, audience and source versions; revisions void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=25+24+35=84, gross=16, upkeep=4, net=12. High assumes reusable sources and 40% less initial composition time; low assumes specialist checking erases that gain while upkeep remains.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Plan dietary, nutritional or epidemiological research methods
Conduct research under the agreed protocol

tasks.design: Retain protocol design, research conduct and interpretation as professional work. Existing {DOCS} support documentation; the unspecified study method does not justify an automated analysis or invented transcription baseline.
tasks.previous_blocker: Different study designs need different evidence collection and validity checks.
tasks.enabler_now: No general-purpose new capability establishes a saving for this broad task.
tasks.still_hard: Bias, confounding, participant protection and interpretation.
tasks.human_edge: Select valid methods and distinguish association from supported conclusions.
tasks.altitude: Research responsibilities and time remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Understand preanalytical variation and measurement limits

evidence.claim: Research method and dataset details are necessary before identifying a defensible automation saving.

assumptions: Boundary covers dietitian research effort only; participant and collaborator work remain outside it.
Dietitian produces the protocol in s1 and study evidence in s2; capture effort remains counted. No structured analysis dataset or free data cleaning is assumed.
Evaluate native study tools for a specified protocol first. This unchanged design creates no incremental upkeep.
research_questions: Which protocol-specific repetitive action could change without weakening study validity?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0, upkeep=0, net=0. Unspecified research is not treated as a routine reporting job; no study activity loses time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Plan training programmes for the audience and setting
Conduct dietetics, nutrition and institutional management training

tasks.design: Keep audience-specific session planning and live training with the dietitian. Use existing {DOCS} teaching materials; their preparation belongs to the separate materials task and earns no second saving here.
tasks.previous_blocker: Effective training depends on audience understanding and live questions.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing material access supports delivery without changing teaching time.
tasks.still_hard: Adapting instruction to mixed knowledge and practical constraints.
tasks.human_edge: Notice misunderstanding and demonstrate sound reasoning.
tasks.altitude: Teaching time and educational responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Translate training into practical care situations

evidence.claim: Material drafting does not itself shorten live instruction or audience-specific teaching decisions.

assumptions: Boundary is session planning and delivery, excluding material authoring counted in task 322 and learner attendance time.
The dietitian produces the delivery plan in s1; no structured learner profile or automatic teaching decisions are assumed.
Use existing document and training configuration first. Unchanged delivery has zero new upkeep.
research_questions: What do learners misunderstand during practical application?

incremental.description: No additional teaching system or upkeep

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=30+70=100, gross=0, upkeep=0, net=0. Session adaptation and live instruction retain all time; material drafting gains are counted only in the separate task.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Scheduling and material drafts may take less time; clinical allocation, research and live teaching retain their professional scope.
reach: Coordinate appointment access with patient representatives
Check teaching comprehension with dietetic technicians
role.ambitious_version: A dietitian who coordinates access and prepares traceable teaching materials with less repetitive composition while preserving research and teaching judgement.
